reference.configuration: Original Bars-family diagram informed by the archival surfaced photograph, with the game’s single 75 mm main gun and two light AA mounts. This is a game-fit interpretation, not a facsimile of a particular dated refit; historical deck armament varied. The catalog represents four internal torpedo tubes, so removed external drop collars are not invented. Hull and small plan detail are simplified.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
